Job Description - Full Stack AI / GenAI Engineer
Role: Full Stack AI / GenAI Engineer
Experience: 6+ Years
Location: Chennai
Shift timing: 2PM - 11 PM
Job Summary
We are looking for a hands-on Full Stack AI / GenAI Engineer with strong experience in frontend and backend development, Generative AI, Agentic AI, system design, and API/integration development.
The ideal candidate should be capable of designing and developing scalable applications that combine modern full-stack technologies with GenAI and Agentic AI capabilities.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop responsive and scalable frontend applications using modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar technologies.
Develop robust backend services, microservices, and business logic using technologies such as Python, Java, Node.js, or .NET.
Build and integrate Generative AI/LLM-based applications using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or similar platforms.
Develop RAG-based applications, prompt workflows, embeddings, vector search, and LLM-powered solutions.
Design and implement Agentic AI solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar technologies.
Develop AI agents capable of tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, decision-making, and multi-step task execution.
Design scalable and reliable application architectures for AI-powered and enterprise applications.
Develop and integrate REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and third-party APIs.
Implement authentication and security mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0, JWT, and API security.
Integrate frontend, backend, AI services, databases, enterprise applications, and third-party systems.
Participate in system design, architecture discussions, technical decisions, and performance optimization.
Ensure applications are scalable, secure, maintainable, and production-ready.




Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
